key_facts: Critic Scott Sneddon of Sesaya Arts Magazine reviews '100% Real Human', Second City Toronto's 92nd Mainstage Revue.
The show, directed by Rob Baker with music director Steve Cruickshank, plays on anxiety about AI and what counts as human.
Sketches include a Willy Wonka whose chocolate factory is now a data centre and an alien invasion skit pleading for humanity's worth.
Cast named include Gavin Pounds, Tim Blair, Chelsea Larkin, Antony Hall, Monica Garrido Huerta and Gillian Bartolucci.
The review is strongly positive and says it runs about 90 minutes plus an interval at 110 Harbour Street.
quote_evidence: "100% Real Human? Certified and authenticated. And 100% real hilarious."
"It's abundantly clear that no algorithms were harmed (or consulted) in the making of this show."
why_it_matters_hint: Shows AI anxiety becoming comedy material on stage.
title: Review: New Second City show is “100% Real Human.” (No algorithm is this funny!)
